steps.instruction: Two existing tests fail: 'toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked' and 'toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked' — each click results in the item NOT toggling (expected false to be true). Most likely a single user click is toggling twice (net no change) because the checkbox's change/click event bubbles up to the row's click handler, or the handlers resolve the wrong item. Fix so that: (1) `toggleWatched(id: number)` calls `store.toggleWatched(id)` exactly once per invocation, keyed by the item's id taken from the row/track expression (never an array index or position). (2) The checkbox input's event stops propagation (e.g. use (change)="toggleWatched(item.id); $event.stopPropagation()" or have onRowClick ignore events whose target is the checkbox) so clicking the checkbox does not also fire the row handler. (3) onRowClick toggles the movie whose id is passed in. Keep displaying items via the store's `orderedItems` signal (unwatched first). No other behaviour changes.
